answer: Cosignatures are collected in pearl, verified in falcon, and shale names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 6 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. That is 1555 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
